fl_3dec57d1.role_title: Full‑Stack Engineer & Generative AI Solutions Specialist
fl_3dec57d1.job_text:
Aditya Kumar is a proactive full‑stack engineer with a strong focus on building AI‑enhanced web applications. Leveraging a solid foundation in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node.js, he has delivered multiple production‑grade solutions for global clients on Upwork, consistently achieving 100% client satisfaction. His freelance tenure (Dec 2025 – May 2026) showcases an ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, maintainable architectures while integrating cutting‑edge generative AI models such as Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI to automate analytics and decision‑making workflows.

During a focused internship at Larsen & Toubro (Jun 2025 – Jul 2025), Aditya engineered a Campus Gateway system that supports over 500 employees with 99.9% uptime. By optimizing MySQL queries and implementing connection pooling, he reduced response latency by roughly 65%, demonstrating a keen eye for performance tuning and reliability. His contributions to code reviews and architectural discussions further underline his collaborative mindset and commitment to best‑practice documentation.

Aditya’s personal projects reinforce his expertise in end‑to‑end system design. "RoastCo" is an AI‑native CRM that converts natural‑language prompts into automated segmentation and personalized campaigns, employing Supabase and Gemini AI for real‑time insights. "UniEd" is a full‑stack ed‑tech platform featuring role‑based dashboards, WebRTC‑powered live classes, and AI‑driven interview simulations, all deployed on Vercel with CI/CD pipelines and Google Cloud integration. These projects illustrate his proficiency in microservices, event‑driven architectures, and cloud‑native deployments.

Beyond coding, Aditya has earned multiple certifications—including Oracle Cloud Infrastructure AI Foundation Associate and MongoDB Atlas—while consistently sharpening his algorithmic skills with over 300 solved LeetCode problems. His active participation in high‑visibility hackathons (Top 15 in a 25,000‑participant AI hackathon) and contributions to 60+ open‑source repositories reflect a passion for continuous learning and community engagement. This blend of technical depth, AI fluency, and proven delivery makes him a valuable asset for organizations seeking innovative, full‑stack solutions powered by generative AI.
